body:
In the following, let's focus on the potential bug that a task store is not shared amongst devs.
when a dev cloned the repo and opened the solace app:

on the migration tab when I loaded up the solace app, I see nothing there:

Yes, this is a bug, and it hides a second, bigger one: on a fresh clone of this
  repo, there's currently no way to migrate its Gleam projects at all. I haven't
  changed any code for either.

  
The screen draws nothing for the "no migration" state. The server answers
normally with state: "none". The Migration screen has views only for available,
running, failed and copying. Anything else hits _ -> h.text("") at
solace-cli/migration/src/migration.gleam:596, so you get a blank page with no
explanation.

  
This repo's projects can't be migrated, from the board or the CLI.
Why "none": migrate::candidates (solace-cli/src/migrate.rs:954) offers nothing
to migrate when the folder is already a Solace root. The committed
solace.toml lists projects, so ~/dev/solace always counts as one.
Projects button: adding an existing project in place (workspace::add) is
refused on purpose ("Existing code comes into Solace by migrating it"),
following D-59.
CLI: I tried solace migrate --yes --project solace-cli/board on the throwaway
clone. It says "Nothing to migrate here", so the README's multi-project
migrate command fails for this repo.
title: Fix: task store available to other devs
